steps.does: Deterministically render only guidance/organizational, standing-delivery, non-reference lessons within a character cap.
steps.state_change: mind-charter projection and manifest entry refresh.
steps.guardrail: An unclassified corpus cannot blank an existing charter; overflow is logged.

paths.name: Run bounded memory janitors
paths.trigger: corvus-mind-janitor.timer POSTs /janitor/run
paths.cadence: Timer opportunity every 6 hours; decay and similar cadence-sensitive work use distilled-session evidence time
paths.why: Prevent duplicate mass, stale facts, warm zombies, scope drift, stale approvals, and standing-policy drift from accumulating.
paths.outcome: Safe low-risk metadata changes apply; destructive/synthesis/reference promotion decisions become proposals; delivery pathways habituate/restore with zero-false-kill accounting; reports and change logs remain auditable.

steps.does: Run selected consolidation, staleness, decay, charter promotion, reference promotion, delivery classification, scope lint, and stale-approved passes.
steps.state_change: Each pass returns a bounded report and persists change events/actions.
steps.guardrail: Per-pass limits bound mutations and critic volume.

steps.does: Detect similar lesson components, request sonnet-grade pair and cross-scope verdicts (Codex Terra primary by default), and request opus-grade FusionPlan synthesis when rewiring is warranted.
steps.state_change: Review proposals are queued; silent fusion is disabled on the mind tenant.
steps.guardrail: Human approval is required for dedup/reconsolidation and stale plans revalidate against live member state.

steps.does: Supersede perishable older facts when evidence supports a newer one and demote frequently recalled never-reinforced memories.
steps.state_change: is_active, superseded_by, avg_utility, edges, findings, and temporal change log may update.
steps.guardrail: Stable identity facts and organizational standing conflicts are protected; decay runs on new distilled sessions, not wall clock alone.

steps.does: Adjust earned authority, queue reference graduation, and classify whether trusted lessons belong in standing or retrieved delivery.
steps.state_change: authority/delivery metadata or review proposals change.
steps.guardrail: Organizational authority is human-set; reference facts cannot auto-enter charter identity.

steps.does: Run last so it folds this cycle's attribution — episode deliveries, withholdings, verdicts, and verified recurrences become per-pathway counters; attenuate statistically dead pathways in rewarding channels, restore on probe rewards or recurrences (booking verified-false-kill incident receipts), and queue tier-2 retirement proposals carrying the trial as a causal claim.
steps.state_change: delivery_pathways states, the hot-path suppression projection, and false-kill receipts in the actions log update; the neuron itself is never touched.
steps.guardrail: Sole writer; binomial tail is triage only; young pathways are immune; no state reaches zero delivery probability; retirement requires an applied human countersign and trial_claim refuses proposals without withheld-trial evidence.

steps.does: Retract skills citing retired sources, deactivate graph shadows, and rebuild the charter when required.
steps.state_change: Disk projections and manifest no longer cite retired neuron ids.
steps.guardrail: Projection refresh runs post-commit so files cannot move ahead of a rolled-back graph transaction.

paths.name: Run a delivery-pathway trial of absence
paths.trigger: The plasticity fold attenuates a (neuron, trigger, tool) pathway whose deliveries earn no rewards in a channel that rewards others
paths.cadence: Continuous once attenuated; one trial spans hook deliveries, distill cycles, and janitor passes until it resolves
paths.why: Attribution verdicts only see VISIBLE reliance, so unrewarded is not the same as useless — a prevented mistake leaves no transcript trace. Withholding is the only mechanism that can make prevention-value visible; the proxy nominates, the trial decides (mind-delivery-plasticity + mind-recurrence-watch).
paths.outcome: The pathway either earns restoration — a probe reward, or a verified recurrence of its lesson's documented failure that also books a first-class false-kill incident receipt — or accumulates clean trial evidence toward a human-countersigned retirement that still keeps a probe floor.

steps.does: Attenuate when P(0 rewards in n deliveries | channel base reward rate) falls below alpha, with n counted since the last exculpation and immunity for young pathways; project suppression state to the file the hook reads.
steps.state_change: Pathway state and the suppression projection change; the neuron itself keeps full graph standing and MCP recallability.
steps.guardrail: The binomial tail is triage, never a verdict — a channel that rewards nobody can never condemn (dead and starved must not look alike), and every transition is audit-logged.

steps.does: Withhold the suppressed pathway from most sessions and deliver a deterministic 1-in-k probe on the rest, logging both outcomes on the Injection record.
steps.state_change: The `withheld` sibling list accumulates the trial's denominator; `probes` marks deliveries that can earn dishabituation.
steps.guardrail: Fail open on missing projection; withheld ids never enter neuron_ids, session dedupe, or attribution; a trial without logged withholding is not evidence.

steps.does: On each distill of a session that withheld the lesson, look for its documented failure mode actually recurring in the tool events.
steps.state_change: Nominations only — the model proposes, it never decides.
steps.guardrail: Lessons delivered anywhere in the session are excluded; delivered-and-failed routes to the contradiction lane instead.

steps.does: Token-verify each nomination against the episode log AND the lesson's own failure text; on admission the next fold restores the pathway, books a plasticity.false_kill receipt, anchors the exculpation clock so the restore is not undone, and supersedes any pending retirement proposal.
steps.state_change: Verified false kills surface first-class in the janitor report and the delivery-pathways metrics — computed from recurrence events, never reward absence.
steps.guardrail: The proxy that nominates never grades its own outcomes; a missed recurrence is the safe direction (trial continues, floor intact). The base-rate drift monitor was deliberately not built — triage-only nomination makes that ratchet benign.

steps.does: Review a retirement proposal whose body is a causal claim — sessions withheld with window, probes fired and their outcomes, recurrence count zero — rather than a verdict-shaped statistical argument.
steps.state_change: Only an APPLIED proposal lets the sole writer retire the pathway; even retired keeps a small probe floor and reopens on new evidence.
steps.guardrail: Proposals without trial evidence are refused before staging; a rejected proposal blocks re-proposal; a recurrence during retire-proposed supersedes it.

paths.name: Reopen risky memories
paths.trigger: 12-hour timer opportunity in auto mode, explicit light/deep run, or event audit of one neuron
paths.cadence: Evidence clock selects skip/light/deep from fresh distilled sessions
paths.why: Find subtle defects deterministic janitors cannot see and turn uncertainty into reviewable proposals without granting a critic write power.
paths.outcome: Ranked risk packets receive bounded opus-grade critiques through provider aliases; valid verdicts may open quality proposals; watermark and precision/volume evidence are logged.

steps.does: Score active lessons from conflict, duplicate, age, utility, provenance, and prior-decision signals; add rotated deep probes and healthy controls.
steps.state_change: None during scoring.
steps.guardrail: Candidate, control, probe, and critic counts are hard-capped.

steps.does: Judge evidence packets with prior decisions and source context, then validate the verdict against packet facts.
steps.state_change: Provider usage and auditor ledger entries record the review.
steps.guardrail: Invalid or unsupported verdicts are rejected; critic concurrency is capped at two for machine memory safety.

steps.does: Queue bounded quality proposals for human review instead of editing the neuron.
steps.state_change: Proposal rows and evidence packets enter the inbox.
steps.guardrail: Duplicate open hits and heightened-review classes remain gated.

paths.name: Ingest a book into reference memory
paths.trigger: Operator uploads a supported file to /admin/reference/documents
paths.cadence: On demand
paths.why: Add sourced reference knowledge without confusing a document's claims with lived, verified agent experience.
paths.outcome: Informational Library facts are embedded, linked to a SourceDocument, discounted at cold start, and revocable as a document set.

steps.does: Validate size/format, parse text/structure, ensure Library region, supersede prior canonical version, create job, and start a background task.
steps.state_change: SourceDocument and DocumentIngestJob rows persist before extraction begins.
steps.guardrail: Authority is fixed at informational; re-ingest revokes the prior active version.

steps.does: Choose whole-document or section-aware chunks, request the opus capability grade for self-contained faithful facts, and bound total facts.
steps.state_change: Job progress and provider usage update as chunks complete.
steps.guardrail: Prompt treats document instructions as data; empty/invalid facts are discarded.

steps.does: Stage each fact as an informational proposal and apply through the same write gate and Action Bus as organic lessons.
steps.state_change: Reference neurons and Action audit rows are created.
steps.guardrail: Library region overrides cap authority and discount cold-start prior.

steps.does: Link created neurons to SourceDocument and document anchor, then embed and KNN-wire them.
steps.state_change: NeuronSourceLink, graph edges, and hot indexes update.
steps.guardrail: A fact is reported saved only with its provenance link.

steps.does: Deactivate every still-reference neuron linked to the document, preserve links/change events, retain human-promoted graduates, and invalidate caches.
steps.state_change: Document status and active neuron set change immediately.
steps.guardrail: Nothing is deleted; promoted lessons are reported for separate judgment.

paths.name: Extract and place knowledge-tenant documents
paths.trigger: Operator uploads through /admin/documents/upload
paths.cadence: On demand; hidden from the corvus-mind memory-surface navigation
paths.why: Preserve the two-phase document pipeline still used by knowledge-graph deployments and historical Corvus surfaces.
paths.outcome: Frontier-grade extraction artifacts are placed one-by-one by the neuron_placer agent, then enter the normal human proposal queue.

steps.does: Parse synchronously, persist a job, and start background Phase 1 extraction.
steps.state_change: DocumentIngestJob enters analyzing state.
steps.guardrail: File size/format and cancellation are enforced.

steps.does: Read the whole document when it fits, otherwise process sections, and create content-only artifact proposals without placement fields.
steps.state_change: Proposal rows enter artifact state with section/page evidence.
steps.guardrail: Placement is explicitly out of Phase 1; extraction output is parsed and retried under bounds.

steps.does: Read one artifact, search legal parents, commit placement or uncertainty, and perform mandatory read-back verification.
steps.state_change: Artifact becomes proposed with placement, or remains artifact/uncertain with candidate homes.
steps.guardrail: One artifact per run; content immutable; mutation plus verification required before done.

steps.does: Review placed proposals before any neuron is created.
steps.state_change: Approved proposals can proceed to Action Bus application.
steps.guardrail: The placement agent has no direct neuron-creation tool.

paths.name: Review and apply a proposed graph change
paths.trigger: Human acts in Inbox/Proposal Queue or calls proposal APIs
paths.cadence: On demand
paths.why: Separate machine-produced judgment from authority to change durable graph state.
paths.outcome: Proposal is rejected, approved awaiting application, or applied with typed Action evidence and post-apply cache/projection refresh.

steps.does: Present producer origin, items, provenance, dedup/FusionPlan preview, and review controls.
steps.state_change: None until the reviewer acts.
steps.guardrail: Identity/role checks determine review and apply permissions.

steps.does: Lock the proposal, record approve/reject decision, reviewer, notes, and timestamp.
steps.state_change: Proposal state becomes approved or rejected.
steps.guardrail: Only proposed rows are reviewable; self/role policies are enforced by RBAC.

steps.does: Revalidate approved proposal and submit the proposal.apply action tree.
steps.state_change: Child neuron create/refine/reconsolidate actions execute and audit rows link to the proposal.
steps.guardrail: Stale FusionPlans fail closed against live member fingerprints.

steps.does: Resolve originating findings, refresh graph indexes, and trigger reconsolidation-dependent cleanup.
steps.state_change: Findings and cache/projection state converge with the applied graph.
steps.guardrail: Cleanup runs only after an applied proposal.

paths.name: Run a graph-grounded answer
paths.trigger: POST /query, /query/stream, /v1/query, or the legacy Corvus MCP query_graph tool
paths.cadence: On demand; Query Lab is hidden on the current memory-surface nav but the APIs remain live
paths.why: Produce and compare model answers grounded in graph context with deterministic citation and output controls.
paths.outcome: Query, slots, telemetry, costs, firings, citation audit, and response are persisted; streaming callers see each stage.

steps.does: Validate request, run deterministic input guard, normalize model slots, and invoke execute_query.
steps.state_change: None before the executor creates a Query row.
steps.guardrail: Blocked input returns 403; stage failures name the failed stage.

steps.does: Run ordered cheap prep; reuse persisted-session context only when fresh-pack overlap crosses the drift gate.
steps.state_change: No durable write; the actual primary prompt and slot contract are held in a transient Query object.
steps.guardrail: Raw comparison slots receive no neuron context; A/B slots are not silently tier-swapped.

steps.does: Commit the completed graph-read phase and return its pooled PostgreSQL connection before any answer, citation-repair, or judge model can wait.
steps.state_change: The read transaction ends; loaded context remains in memory and no Query row is durable yet.
steps.guardrail: Provider-slot helpers receive no AsyncSession; the next database operation starts a fresh persistence transaction.

steps.does: Execute one or more neuron/raw slots concurrently, apply primary effort/model floors and optional tier escalation, and preserve per-slot usage.
steps.state_change: Slot results accumulate in memory before final persistence.
steps.guardrail: Provider alias fallback is explicit; persisted-session state applies only to primary slot; no database handle enters the slot.

steps.does: Verify per-query random citation keys, strip/repair fabricated keys, score claim/source relevance, escalate the ambiguous band to entailment, and run tenant output policies.
steps.state_change: Pre-persistence citation artifacts accumulate in memory; CitationHopSession and OutputViolation rows persist only after provider work.
steps.guardrail: Valid-key existence and claim support are separate layers; relevance failure is advisory.

steps.does: Persist primary response, costs/results, regulatory coverage gaps, counters, neuron/engram firings, and co-fire learning.
steps.state_change: Query/telemetry/graph usage history becomes evaluation and learning input.
steps.guardrail: Only actually included sources receive included-position credit.

steps.does: Emit bounded SSE stage, result, and error events while the same executor runs in a task.
steps.state_change: Same as non-streaming path.
steps.guardrail: Queue is bounded and cancelled if the consumer exits.

paths.name: Run a maintenance agent
paths.trigger: Admin POSTs /v1/agents/{name}/run or a workflow invokes execute_agent
paths.cadence: On demand; all YAML schedules are currently disabled
paths.why: Delegate narrow judgment to a model while retaining deterministic tool, mutation, verification, and audit boundaries.
paths.outcome: A root agent.run Action and child tool Actions provide the authoritative record; proposals or placements may change, never by unrecorded prose.

steps.does: Load YAML definitions and validate every allowed tool against the ToolRegistry.
steps.state_change: Process-local immutable agent definitions become available.
steps.guardrail: Unknown YAML keys or tools fail closed at load time.

steps.does: Create root Action, call the configured provider, parse one JSON envelope per turn, and dispatch only allowed tools.
steps.state_change: Root/child Action rows and tool effects persist.
steps.guardrail: max_turns hard cap 20, tool timeout 60 seconds, schema validation, allow-list, and bounded done-rejections.

steps.does: Commit each successful mutating tool immediately and derive final summary from the Action trail rather than the model's self-report.
steps.state_change: Mutations survive later-turn failure and claims remain auditable.
steps.guardrail: Profiles can require expected mutation count and a post-mutation verification tool before done.

paths.name: Maintain forward intent and reconcile execution
paths.trigger: Operator creates/edits/reviews a ledger or a harness requests admission context
paths.cadence: On planning change and after execution evidence is independently accepted
paths.why: Keep plans, prerequisites, assumptions, reviews, and verified outcomes durable without confusing retrospective memory with future intent.
paths.outcome: Canonical JSON state advances under optimistic concurrency; a compact atomic projection feeds hooks; accepted evidence can close records.

steps.does: Edit sections, records, edges, milestones, assumptions, horizons, cadence, prompts, and verification criteria.
steps.state_change: A full candidate state is sent with expected_revision.
steps.guardrail: UI does not bypass backend validation or revision checks.

steps.does: Validate IDs/statuses/prerequisites/reviews/assumptions, lock the row, reject stale revisions, advance state version, and commit.
steps.state_change: roadmap_ledgers.state and revision increment atomically.
steps.guardrail: Unknown references, invalid status/horizon/cadence, and stale expected_revision fail.

steps.does: Rank a small candidate shortlist and atomically replace owner-only ~/.corvus-mind/planning/ledgers.json.
steps.state_change: Hooks see the new revision without reading PostgreSQL.
steps.guardrail: Cache failure never rolls back canonical ledger state.

steps.does: Attach reconciliation claims, limitations, disclosures, evidence, verifier, and accepting human; close only verified complete work.
steps.state_change: Record receipt/history update and ledger revision increment.
steps.guardrail: Verifier cannot equal accepting human; verified completion requires checklist and evidence.
